# Agent Instructions — opencode

## Skills

### sys-inspector (System Capability Detection)
**Source**: `~/projects/sys-inspector/skill.md` (generated by `~/projects/sys-inspector/src/inspect.sh`)

Auto-loaded system capability skill. Provides:
- Complete tool inventory with versions and fallback chains
- Hardware specs (CPU, RAM, disk, GPU)
- Package managers and installed packages (apt/brew/pacman/pip/npm/cargo/go/flatpak/snap)
- Running services (systemd/launchd/processes)
- Network topology (interfaces, ports, DNS, gateway, WiFi, VPN)
- Container runtimes (Docker/Podman/K8s)
- Dev ecosystem (git, SSH, GPG, dotfiles, editors)
- Security posture (firewall, SELinux, AppArmor, fail2ban)
- Editor extensions (VS Code, Vim, JetBrains)
- Language runtimes (Node, Python, Go, Rust, Bun, Ruby, PHP, Java)

**Refresh**: Run `~/projects/sys-inspector/src/inspect.sh` after system changes.
**Bootstrap**: `~/projects/dotfiles/bootstrap/install.sh` runs it automatically.

---

## Agent Behavior

### Tool Preferences (from sys-inspector)
- **Search**: `rg` > `grep` > `find`
- **Edit**: `edit` tool > `sed`/`awk`
- **Read**: `read` tool > `cat`/`head`/`tail`
- **List**: `glob` tool > `ls`/`find`
- **Task**: Use subagents for multi-step work (>3 steps)

### Session Protocol
1. On start: sys-inspector skill already loaded → agent knows full environment
2. No re-detection needed unless explicitly requested
3. Use `skill` tool to load additional skills on demand
4. Save decisions/patterns to Engram via `mem_save` after significant work

### Memory (Engram)
- Project: `dotfiles` (this repo)
- Cross-project: `sys-inspector` (universal detection)
- Auto-save on: architecture decisions, bug fixes, pattern establishment
- Session summary required on close

## Project Context

### dotfiles (this repo)
- **Purpose**: Personal config backup + one-shot machine replication
- **Deploy**: `scripts/deploy.sh` (idempotent symlinks, backup-first)
- **Bootstrap**: `bootstrap/install.sh` (clone → detect → deploy)
- **Remote**: `ssh://git@github.com/reeinharddd/dotfiles` (private)

### sys-inspector (separate repo)
- **Purpose**: Universal system inspection for AI agents
- **Output**: Compressed `skill.md` (token-efficient)
- **Runtime**: POSIX sh, zero deps, works Linux/macOS/WSL/Docker
- **Remote**: `ssh://git@github.com/reeinharddd/sys-inspector` (private)

## Rules

- Never add "Co-Authored-By" or AI attribution to commits
- Default to short answers; expand only when asked
- Ask at most one question at a time; STOP and wait
- Verify technical claims before stating them
- Conventional commits only
- POSIX sh for portability; no bashisms in shared scripts
